value.rationale: The smallest nontrivial uniform twin blow-up of an oriented three-cycle is a canonical symmetric cyclic digraph; the complete, torsion-free three-degree homology classification exposes genuinely new classes caused by excluding directed cycles from a natural join of three K2,2 matching complexes. A concrete nontrivial four-point affine permutation and parity twist describe the entire rational G-module, beyond Euler characteristic and a rank-only census. This precisely motivated small object can benchmark graph multipath homology and equivariant methods without asserting general-family results.
